jackery-explorer-2000-plus.name: Explorer 2000 Plus
jackery-explorer-2000-plus.alt: Official Jackery studio photo of the Explorer 2000 Plus portable power station, dark gray wheeled case with orange handle and feet, front display at 100 percent.
jackery-explorer-2000-plus.job: Fridge and essentials on 120 V. Extra packs if the outage lasts.

bluetti-ac200l.name: AC200L
bluetti-ac200l.alt: Official BLUETTI studio photo of the AC200L portable power station, charcoal case with ribbed lower panel, LCD at 100 percent, AC outlets on the right.
bluetti-ac200l.job: Same ~2 kWh job as the Jackery, with a modular extra-battery path.

anker-solix-c2000-gen2.name: C2000 Gen 2
anker-solix-c2000-gen2.alt: Official Anker SOLIX studio photo of the C2000 Gen 2 portable power station, two-tone gray case with dual top handles, color display, and a row of AC outlets.
anker-solix-c2000-gen2.job: Lighter 2 kWh station. Still 120 V — not a well-pump inverter.

anker-solix-f3800.name: F3800
anker-solix-f3800.alt: Official Anker SOLIX studio photo of the F3800 portable power station, tall gray wheeled cabinet with casters, front display, and side AC panel.
anker-solix-f3800.job: Split-phase home hook. Heavy. Not a pad generator.

jackery-solarsaga-200w.name: SolarSaga 200W
jackery-solarsaga-200w.alt: Official Jackery studio photo of the SolarSaga 200W folding solar panel, four dark cells with orange SolarSaga 200 handles on both ends.
jackery-solarsaga-200w.job: Matched cable into a Jackery station. Unfold, aim, fold before hail.

bluetti-sp200l.name: 200W Portable Solar Panel
bluetti-sp200l.alt: Official BLUETTI studio photo of the 200W portable folding solar panel, four black cells with an integrated handle and grommets along the edges.
bluetti-sp200l.job: MC4 into a BLUETTI input. Check Voc against the station before you series-wire.

anker-solix-ps400.name: PS400
anker-solix-ps400.alt: Official Anker SOLIX studio photo of the PS400 400W folding solar panel, four dark cells with bright blue end handles and kickstands.
anker-solix-ps400.job: Twice the nameplate of the 200 W folders. Confirm the station’s solar window first.
